expo.name: T1DReach

infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: T1DReach uses your location while you use the app to create a reduced-precision location for nearby community matching. Your exact GPS location is not shown to other members.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: T1DReach uses the camera only when you choose to take a profile or Community photo.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: T1DReach uses your photo library only when you choose a profile or Community photo.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: T1Together does not need to save photos to your library.

expo.description: Your T1D community within reach. A community for people living with Type 1 diabetes, parents, caregivers, and supporters.
